headline: Launcher 0.9.0 ships, with PCSX2 save imports and Ratchet & Clank fixes
summary: Launcher 0.9.0 is released, with fixes for Gaspar's missing lava, pause-menu save loading and remembered language and sound settings. A new Import saves from PCSX2 command reads a memory-card file or folder card, backs up OpenRAC's card and copies the game's saves (#55). Android disc setup gains visible error messages and Rebuild (#58). Master also receives direct development changes throughout the day, rather than moving only through its usual release pull request.
highlights: The hoverboard girl grows correctly, and vendor icons survive in-level movies (#52, #59). The launcher also gains its new logo and branch selection for updates from forks (#51).
Later work replaces Play with mods and Purist mode with a Mods switch below Play, off by default (#62).
Lighting preparation shows finer progress and estimated time remaining, resumes interrupted work and runs at lower priority to keep the computer usable.
Page transitions are disabled without WebKit compositing to address Steam Deck crashes (#63). A Wayland/NVIDIA fix also lands, but was not tested on NVIDIA hardware (#68).
Ratchet keeps his oxygen mask in Gemlik's ship scenes, and Umbris's water puzzle loses wrongly drawn slabs (#65, #69). The PAL Video page gains draft translations, tested on PAL (#67).
#50, the Android Python setup error, closes as completed. #64 reports launcher 0.9.0 crashes on Steam Deck, and #66 reports an unrecognised Going Commando disc serial.
